comment: D1 — MLS / E2EE basic protocol vectors. Spec authority: crypto-media/encryption-and-audit.md + extensions/mls-binding.md. Each MLS commit Move advances a group through epochs (RFC 9420 MLS protocol). Genesis Move creates epoch 0; subsequent commits join/leave members and advance to epoch N+1. covered_frontier or-set accumulates the governance refs each commit attests to. Encryption AAD digest pins the Move's ciphertext to the active group state — a bit-flip in any covered byte must produce a different digest, which the recipient verifies before decryption.

encoder.aad_digest: SHA-256 over canonical (move_id || epoch_id || tree_hash || covered_frontier_root)

vectors.name: genesis_move_creates_epoch_zero
vectors.comment: MLS group genesis: a creator Move (ak.mls.genesis) writes epoch=0, group_state=initial tree, covered_frontier=∅. The realm_id is fresh; no prior epoch exists and sequenced_state admits the genesis revision.

expected.rationale: Genesis Move installs the initial group state at epoch 0; covered_frontier starts empty; no prior epoch to conflict with.

vectors.name: epoch_advance_via_commit_zero_to_one
vectors.comment: An MLS commit Move advances the epoch sequenced_state from 0 to 1, replaces the group_state tree_hash with a new one, and adds the attested governance ref to covered_frontier.

expected.rationale: Commit advances epoch 0→1 atomically with all three cell writes; covered_frontier accumulates the attested governance ref.

vectors.name: member_join_via_commit
vectors.comment: MLS commit that adds a member: bob joins the group. The group_state.members set grows; epoch advances; covered_frontier accumulates the join-attesting governance ref.

expected.rationale: Member-add MLS commit; epoch advances 1→2; bob joins the group_state members set.

vectors.name: member_leave_via_commit
vectors.comment: MLS commit that removes a member: bob leaves. The group_state.members set shrinks; tree is re-computed without bob's leaf. Epoch advances. covered_frontier still accumulates.

expected.rationale: Member-remove MLS commit; bob is dropped from the group_state.members set; epoch 2→3.

vectors.name: covered_frontier_accumulates_across_three_epochs
vectors.comment: Sequential MLS commits across epochs 0→1→2→3 each add a distinct governance ref to covered_frontier. The or-set lattice surfaces all three refs as the active set (none rotated). Tests the cumulative 'covered_frontier_root' the AAD digest must include.

expected.rationale: Or-set accumulates all three refs across epochs; no rotation; full set is the active surface.

vectors.name: encryption_aad_digest_pinning
vectors.comment: An E2EE message Move's ciphertext carries an Authenticated Associated Data (AAD) digest pin computed over (move_id || epoch_id || tree_hash || covered_frontier_root). A bit-flip in ANY of these inputs must produce a different SHA-256 digest. The recipient recomputes the digest from observed cell state and rejects if mismatched.

expected.rationale: AAD digest pins ciphertext to (move_id, epoch_id, tree_hash, covered_frontier_root). Recipient recomputes and rejects on mismatch.

negative_vectors.name: epoch_skip_rejected
negative_vectors.comment: An MLS commit that claims to advance from epoch 1 to epoch 5 (skipping 2,3,4) MUST reject — epoch advances must be monotonically +1 per commit; gaps indicate dropped commits or malicious replay.

expected.rationale: Epoch advance MUST be exactly prior_epoch + 1; gap of 4 indicates a malformed or replayed commit.

negative_vectors.name: aad_digest_mismatch_rejected
negative_vectors.comment: Recipient observes group_state.tree_hash=X but ciphertext's AAD digest was computed over tree_hash=Y (the sender's stale tree). Recompute MUST diverge → reject pre-decryption.

expected.rationale: Sender's AAD inputs do not match recipient's observed group state; ciphertext is bound to a different state.
